objective: Prove that card-plugin2 can consume real DangoUI components in one Build publish-sheet vertical slice while preserving existing business behavior.
control: environment selector remains the original host component
mustPreserve: existing input limits, placeholders, validation and save-draft handler outcome
publish behavior, environment behavior, cover selection and all routes
mustProve: real component imports and rendered component instances
DangoUI module present in the production bundle
pointer and keyboard behavior plus focus, filled, disabled and validation states
textarea visibility above the fixed action bar and while focused
business-equivalent before/after outcomes with zero external writes during QA
mustNot: claim runtime adoption from --du-* variables, adapter files or CSS class names
replace the environment selector in this experiment
change stores, APIs, routes, validation rules or submission behavior
silently fall back to style-only if DangoUI cannot build or render
expand migration to other pages before the experiment verdict
